div.head: Af El. 15
div.ab: Se þe freonne forsteleþ 7 he hine bebycge, 7 hit onbestæled sy, þæt he hine bereccan ne mæg, swelte se deaþe. — Se þe wyrie his fæder oððe his moder, swelte se deaþe.
Se ðe frione forstele ⁊ he hine bebycgge, ⁊ hit onbestæled sie, þæt he hine bereccean ne mæge, swelte se deaðe. — Se ðe werge his fæder oððe his modor, swelte se deaðe.
Se þe freonne forstele ⁊ hine bebycge, ⁊ hit hym onbestæled sie, þæt he hine bereccan ne mæge, swelte se deaðe. — Se ðe wyrge his fæder oððe modor, swelte se deaðe.
Qui furatus fuerit hominem et uendiderit eum, conuictus noxe, morte moriatur. — Qui maledixerit patri uel matri, morte moriatur.
Se ðe frione forstele ⁊ he hine bebycgge, ⁊ hit onbestæled sie, þæt he hine bereccean ne mæge, swelte se deaðe. Se ðe werge his fæder oððe his modor, swelte se deaðe.
He who steals a free person and sells him, and it should be proved, so that he may not expurgate himself, let him die the death. He who curses his father or his mother, let him die the death.

Wer einen Freien stiehlt und ihn verkauft, und [wenn dem Diebe] es Schuld gegeben wird, dass er sich nicht rechtfertigen kann, der sterbe Todes. — Wer seinen Vater oder seine Mutter verflucht, der sterbe Todes.

Whoever steals a free man and sells him, and [if] it is charged [to the thief] so that he cannot justify himself, let him die the death. — Whoever curses his father or his mother, let him die the death.
